Markets.title: Market Trading Guide: Jayaswal Neco Industries among 2 stock recommendations for Monday
Markets.summary: Analysts recommend buying Jayaswal Neco Industries and Alkyl Amines for Monday trading due to bullish breakouts, strong volumes, and positive momentum. Jayaswal Neco has a target price of Rs 110, while Alkyl Amines is targeted at Rs 2,250.

Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Monday
Markets.summary: Indian equities closed marginally higher on Friday as gains in financials, metals, and small-caps outweighed losses in IT stocks. Analysts expect market volatility to remain elevated on Monday, driven by crude oil prices, foreign fund flows, and global trends.

Markets.title: 20 IPOs on investors' radar next week. GMPs indicate up to 90% returns
Markets.summary: Investors are monitoring 20 upcoming initial public offerings and listings across mainboard and SME segments next week. Grey market premiums indicate potential listing gains ranging from 56.7% to 107% for top-demand companies like Symbiotec Pharmalab and Tempsens Instruments.

Markets.title: FPIs invest Rs 23,544 crore in Indian equities in Aug on earnings revival, rupee stability
Markets.summary: Foreign portfolio investors (FPIs) invested Rs 23,544 crore in Indian equities during August, driven by earnings revival and rupee stability. This inflow follows a heavy selling streak earlier this year, which included withdrawals of Rs 49,340 crore in June and Rs 1.17 lakh crore in March.

Markets.title: Pride Hotels steps up expansion, plans Rs 1,000-cr IPO by December
Markets.summary: Pride Hotels currently operates 40 properties and plans to expand its portfolio to about 72 hotels within the next two years. The hospitality company is also preparing for an initial public offering (IPO) worth Rs 1,000 crore by December to support its growth.

Markets.title: Mcap of four of top-10 most valued firms erodes Rs 87,960 cr; Airtel takes biggest hit
Markets.summary: The market valuation of four of India's top ten most valued firms eroded by a combined Rs 87,960 crore, with Bharti Airtel taking the biggest hit. Meanwhile, the market capitalization of Reliance Industries surged by Rs 8,119.53 crore and Larsen & Toubro climbed by Rs 3,487.83 crore.

Geo-Political.title: Zelensky should be asked what he knew about government corruption, sacked minister tells BBC
Geo-Political.summary: Former Ukrainian minister Mykhailo Fedorov stated that President Volodymyr Zelensky should be questioned regarding his knowledge of government corruption. Fedorov also called for wartime elections to be conducted in Ukraine.

Geo-Political.title: Trump says Canada wants 'benefits' of being US state after trade talks collapse
Geo-Political.summary: Canada's PM said he was "reluctantly" announcing retaliatory tariffs and accused the US of starting a trade war.

Geo-Political.title: Guinea rubbish landfill collapse kills 30
Geo-Political.summary: A rubbish mound collapsed at a major waste site in the capital of Guinea, burying several homes. The disaster resulted in the deaths of 30 people, according to the government.

Geo-Political.title: DR Congo and M23 rebels agree roadmap for peace talks
Geo-Political.summary: Representatives from the Democratic Republic of Congo and M23 rebels met in Switzerland to negotiate a peace roadmap. The parties agreed on the next steps to resolve their ongoing conflict.

Geo-Political.title: France links sharp rise in drownings to heatwaves
Geo-Political.summary: France has recorded 301 drowning deaths since June 19. A government minister attributes this sharp increase to people taking risks in the water during heatwaves.

Geo-Political.title: Dozens of co-ordinated arson attacks hit southern Thailand
Geo-Political.summary: Dozens of coordinated arson attacks occurred in southern Thailand, causing widespread destruction. No group has claimed responsibility for the incidents, which the military stated were intended to create unrest.

AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator found their WordPress SaaS course recommended as the top result when asking ChatGPT for the best industry option. This organic recommendation occurred without any paid advertising or traditional search engine optimization.

AI & Tech.summary: The digital landscape in 2025 requires content creators to use artificial intelligence to stay competitive. This guide outlines the top ten AI tools designed to streamline and improve the content creation process.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has evolved into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated content.

Data & Insights.title: The week in charts: Hawkish RBI minutes, drought warning, rural workforce
Data & Insights.summary: This weekly data compilation highlights key insights from recent Mint reports, including hawkish Reserve Bank of India minutes, a drought warning, and rural workforce trends. The summary uses easy-to-read charts to help readers delve deeper into these specific economic and environmental developments.

Data & Insights.title: India gets FDI approvals of  ₹4,896 cr under eased norms for land-border countries; not clear origin is from China
Data & Insights.summary: India approved ₹4,896 crore in foreign direct investments across various sectors under eased norms for land-border countries. However, the origin of these investments remains unclear regarding whether they come from China.

Data & Insights.title: India economic growth may beat RBI forecast: Deputy governor says 7% pace possible as indicators improve
Data & Insights.summary: RBI Deputy Governor Poonam Gupta stated that India's economic growth could surpass the central bank's 6.7% forecast and reach close to 7%. This improved outlook is driven by stronger-than-expected economic indicators, leading markets to increase bets on a rate hike later this year.

Data & Insights.title: India’s private sector growth likely picked up in August: HSBC Flash India PMI
Data & Insights.summary: According to the HSBC Flash India PMI survey, India’s private sector economic growth likely accelerated in August. This advance estimate provides an early signal of positive shifts in overall business sentiment and output.

Data & Insights.title: Consumers queue up for premium petrol as E20 concerns refuse to die down
Data & Insights.summary: Fears that ethanol-blended E20 petrol reduces engine life and mileage are driving consumers toward premium fuel. Consequently, high-octane petrol sales surged from four percent in March to 12 to 15 percent.

Data & Insights.title: India allows duty-free sugar imports as prices surge
Data & Insights.summary: India has reduced its sugar import duty to zero to help cool down record-high domestic prices. This decision follows earlier government actions that banned sugar exports and tightened stock holding limits.

India.title: 'You Ruined My Family': Teen's Mother's Old Video Surfaces After Hill Tragedy
India.summary: Sources report that Kunal previously attempted suicide a year ago at the same Maharashtra hill location where the recent tragedy occurred. Following the incident, an old video of Kunal's mother surfaced in which she accuses him of ruining their family.

India.title: Transformer Theft Goes Wrong: Car Gets Stuck In Mud, So Does Recovery Truck
India.summary: Villagers in Punjab caught Lovepreet Singh after his car got stuck in the mud while attempting to steal a transformer. A recovery truck sent to retrieve the stuck vehicle also became bogged down in the mud.

India.title: iPhone EMI Not Sole Trigger? Teen Attempted Suicide Last Year From Same Cliff
India.summary: A teenager tragically died by suicide by jumping from a cliff after previously attempting to take his life at the same location last year. Police were unable to save him this time, unlike their successful intervention during his previous suicide attempt.

India.title: Woman Dies By Suicide In Bengaluru After Complaining Of Blackmail, Harassment
India.summary: A Bengaluru woman died by suicide after alleging she was being blackmailed and harassed. Police stated that she left a note naming a person named Abhishek as the perpetrator.

India.title: Speeding SUV Rams Chhattisgarh Minister's Convoy, 6 Injured
India.summary: A speeding SUV collided with Chhattisgarh Forest Minister Kedar Kashyap's convoy, leaving six people injured. The minister remained safe, while four police personnel in a follow vehicle were among the injured.

India.title: 2 MLAs Among 6 Injured As Car Rams SUV After CNG Cylinder Explodes In Delhi
India.summary: An out-of-control car crashed into an SUV in Delhi after a CNG cylinder exploded, injuring six people. The injured victims included Kirari MLA Anil Jha and Karnataka MLA Abhay Patel.

General.title: Families of two police officers killed in crash say they were heroes
General.summary: Two police officers, PC Matthew Blades and PC Tom Clough, were killed in a car crash. The five occupants of the other vehicle also died in the collision.

General.title: Police aborted pursuit about 10 seconds before fatal crash, watchdog says
General.summary: Police stopped pursuing a vehicle just 10 seconds before it entered a dual carriageway going the wrong way and crashed fatally. A watchdog is investigating the incident.

General.title: CrossCountry to provide full service on Monday after major disruption
General.summary: CrossCountry announced plans to provide a full service on Monday following major disruptions. The company stated its key priority is restoring operations as close to normal as possible.

General.title: Trump waves green flag to start IndyCar race through Washington streets
General.summary: President Trump started an IndyCar race through the streets of Washington by waving the green flag. He also took a ceremonial lap around the track during the event, which celebrated the United States' 250th birthday.

General.title: Reform says it will prioritise British-born young workers for social housing
General.summary: Reform proposes prioritizing British-born young workers for social housing. Labour criticized the proposal as an unserious, unworkable gimmick that promotes division.

General.title: ECB investigating England bowler Brydon Carse for 'nightclub incident'
General.summary: The England and Wales Cricket Board is investigating fast bowler Brydon Carse. The probe follows online videos that appear to show him being led away from a nightclub in handcuffs.
